description: This file defines the 'Order' entity class within the ApplicationCore layer of the eShopOnWeb project. It models an order with properties such as BuyerId, OrderDate, shipping address, and a collection of order items. It includes methods for calculating total order price and encapsulates order item collection to adhere to Domain-Driven Design principles.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order with order items, buyer info, and total calculation logic. Implements encapsulation for collection of order items to maintain aggregate consistency.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new order, ensuring buyerId is not null or empty, and sets up order details.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of all order items in the order.
